xpadneo-dkms on Omarchy

Makes your Xbox wireless controller feel first-class on Linux, over Bluetooth.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install xpadneo-dkms on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add xpadneo-dkms. It is a 87.2 KB download (256.9 KB installed), version 0.10.4-1.1, licensed GPL-2.0-only AND GPL-3.0-or-later. Advanced Linux Driver for Xbox One Wireless Gamepad. Free and open source.

Install xpadneo-dkms on Omarchy

xpadneo is a kernel driver that lets Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox Elite Series 2 wireless controllers connect to Linux over Bluetooth with full feature support, not just basic button input. It adds rumble, proportional trigger feedback, battery-level reporting, and paddle button support that the generic in-kernel driver lacks. It started as a student project at fortiss GmbH (affiliated with TU Munich) and is packaged here via DKMS so the kernel module rebuilds automatically across kernel updates.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add xpadneo-dkms
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.10.4-1.1:
    pacman -Qi xpadneo-dkms

Open and use xpadneo-dkms

xpadneo-dkms has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql xpadneo-dkms | grep /usr/bin/

xpadneo-dkms requirements and compatibility

  • A Bluetooth adapter (Bluetooth Low Energy support needed for Xbox Series X|S controllers)
  • An Xbox wireless controller (One S, Series X|S, or Elite Series 2) to pair

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • dkms
  • bluez
  • bluez-utils

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-2.0-only AND GPL-3.0-or-later.

Uninstall xpadneo-dkms

omarchy pkg drop xpadneo-dkms

Frequently asked questions

How do I install xpadneo-dkms on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add xpadneo-dkms. The download is 87.2 KB and it takes 256.9 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is xpadneo-dkms free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-only AND GPL-3.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall xpadneo-dkms?

Run omarchy pkg drop xpadneo-dkms. It removes the package from your system.

What does xpadneo-dkms depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: dkms, bluez, bluez-utils. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is xpadneo-dkms a desktop app?

No. xpadneo-dkms has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is xpadneo-dkms in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as xpadneo-dkms (version 0.10.4-1.1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Florian Dollinger makes it. Project site: https://github.com/atar-axis/xpadneo.
